name: Dumbbell Push Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell resting at each shoulder, elbows slightly forward.
Brace your core and dip a few inches straight down by bending your knees.
Drive explosively through your legs and hips to launch the dumbbells overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower both dumbbells under control back to your shoulders to reset.
tips: Keep your torso upright and heels planted through the quick knee dip.
Finish with your ribs stacked over your hips instead of leaning backward at lockout.
